name: Proving Grounds
summary: In Alterac, recruits face a trial before joining the Stormpike Guard. Lieutenant Haggerdin sends them into Icewing Caverns to recover a planted battle standard. Success earns an official Stormpike Insignia and begins their rise through the expedition’s ranks.

sections.title: A Measure of Courage
sections.body: The Stormpike Guard fights the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley. Lieutenant Haggerdin directs Alliance forces from their encampment in the Alterac Mountains. He tests new recruits before sending them to the battlefield, demanding proof of skill and nerve in Icewing Caverns, southwest of Dun Baldar.

sections.title: The Icewing Caverns
sections.body: A Stormpike banner waits deep in the icy tunnels of Icewing Caverns. Frost harpies nest in the frozen recesses and attack unwary trespassers. Bringing back the banner intact shows a recruit can cross dangerous ground, face the predators, and keep discipline under pressure.

sections.title: The Stormpike Insignia
sections.body: Returning from the caverns with the standard earns a soldier the Stormpike initiate’s insignia and a place in the expeditionary force. Haggerdin promises that the insignia can be improved as a soldier earns greater honor on the battlefield, with honors such as the Eye of Command as a distant aim.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Haggerdin is an Alliance officer in the Alterac Mountains who oversees Stormpike Guard recruitment and field recognition. He tests prospective fighters and rewards their service with military insignias.
Icewing Caverns lie southwest of Dun Baldar, the Alliance stronghold in Alterac Valley. Their winding tunnels run beneath the ice and stone.

faq.q: What threats dwell inside the Icewing Caverns?
faq.answer: Ferocious ice harpies live in Icewing Caverns. Haggerdin warns that they ambush trespassers and tear out their throats.

faq.q: Why does the Stormpike Guard require this test?
faq.answer: The Stormpike Guard fights a brutal war against the Frostwolf orcs. Haggerdin tests recruits before they join the main lines, so every soldier bearing the banner can fight in harsh conditions.

faq.q: What is the reward for completing the proving ground?
faq.answer: A recruit who returns with the standard earns a Stormpike initiate’s insignia. Haggerdin can improve it as the soldier gains honor in Alterac Valley.

faq.q: Who are the Frostwolves mentioned by Haggerdin?
faq.answer: The Frostwolf Clan is an orcish clan that has lived in Alterac Valley since its exile decades ago. The Stormpike Guard sees them as hostile savages who stand in the way of Alliance interests and excavation in the valley.

angles.text: The Stormpike expedition is the Alliance’s main military effort in Alterac. It joins dwarven archaeological ambitions with the defense of Alliance territory against the Horde.
As a dwarf, you enter a guard led mostly by Ironforge dwarves seeking ancestral relics and titan mysteries. The trial can be your first step into one of your race’s proudest military units.
